name: Initial System
changes: Initial rule set: rule-based regime model (6 regimes), 6 screener setups + news/price mismatch, 1.5×ATR stops, ≥2:1 reward/risk, options only when they beat the stock on risk/reward, risk limits 1% per trade / 5% total / 15% options / 15% single position.
reason: Starting point for the paper-trading desk.
evidence: None yet: this is the untested baseline. Rules come from standard practice, not from this desk's results.
expected_effect: Unknown. Establish a measurable baseline; first statistical review at 20 closed trades.
